limitations: This is a bounded text/spelling review, not legal trademark similarity or phonetic clearance. DPMA officially states similarity searching is unavailable.
DPMA DE/EM/IR query checked defaults include German national, Union and international marks; DPMA disclaims correctness/completeness of the EM/IR data.

UPRP review queried its direct public national trademark records in BUP/WUP/E-register; the interface states trademark bibliographic data start at application Z.075001 and granted rights at R.000118. It is not a separate exhaustive EU/WIPO or unregistered-rights search.

No Wandmoss candidate records surfaced in unrestricted-class/status searches, so no candidate goods/services needed assessment. Class 9 (software/downloadable games) and class 41 (online entertainment/game services) remain relevant review categories; DPMA root was additionally queried separately in classes 9 and 41. UPRP zero all-class results logically contain no candidate in either category; no separate UPRP class query was necessary.
Nintendo controls verify the chosen search flow and scope, not completeness of coverage. Invalid or non-submitting attempts were excluded.

limitations: Federal register review only; state and common-law rights were not searched.
CM combines literal mark, pseudo-mark and translations. Phrase queries match the phrase within a mark rather than requiring it to be the entire mark.
Completed searches cover the specified exact/root/spacing spellings, not every phonetic, conceptual or visual similarity.
Wandermoss and Wondermoss additional near-root register searches remain unavailable; no zero result is claimed for them.

A negative bounded result does not establish free use or decide likelihood of confusion.

wipo.issue: Clicking an option element directly had no rendered target; WIPO stayed on Embedded instead of changing to Match exact expression. Query-state validation caught the unchanged Simple strategy. These repeated broad counts are not phrase-search results.
wipo.correction: Use native select focus and ArrowDown/Enter, verify selected strategy before submitting and verify serialized strategy in the resulting URL.

limitations: Bounded title/root/spacing/spelling searches, not exhaustive legal clearance or a comprehensive visual, phonetic and conceptual similarity assessment.
EUIPO basic text search covers EUTM/IR records in its current database; absence is limited to submitted criteria and current data.
WIPO default Embedded multi-word searches produced broad individual-token results; their counts are not counts of exact title matches. Exact-expression queries were separately submitted.

No class or status restrictions were applied, so root/phrase negatives were not created by excluding classes 9 or 41. No returned root or exact-phrase marks were available to inspect for games/software/services.
WIPO collection coverage is incomplete and differs by participating office; relevant national/regional registers and unregistered rights remain outside these negatives.
TMview access error prevented searches; unavailable is not a negative result.
No project files changed, screenshots, contacts, accounts or trademark filings.
USPTO optional Wandermoss/Wondermoss and wildcard/class-expansion queries were interrupted/unsubmitted after HTTP 403; not zero results.
UPRP direct queries succeeded today for this title; this does not retrospectively clear earlier unqueried names.
No exhaustive phonetic, visual or conceptual comparison; no all-country, state-register, company/title/domain or common-law-rights clearance.
Ordinary Journey/Moss/Wand token marks were not exhaustively reviewed; the submitted distinctive-root and phrase queries define the result scope.
Snapshot results and known-mark controls do not guarantee complete/current coverage or decide likelihood of confusion.
decision: The defined register-review backlog task is complete with documented scope/access limits; no concrete conflicting registration identified in completed queries. The owner retains publication and name-risk decisions.
